# JsgSmile MSME Portal - Jharsuguda Synergy for MSME and Industry Linkage Ecosystem

> Official MSME & Industry Linkage Procurement Portal for Jharsuguda District, Odisha, India.
> Connects MSMEs, Buyers, Sellers, SHGs, and Large Industries for digital procurement.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://msme-pugarch-frontend.vercel.app/)
- [Marketplace](https://msme-pugarch-frontend.vercel.app/marketplace)
- [Seller Registration](https://msme-pugarch-frontend.vercel.app/seller/register)
- [Buyer Registration](https://msme-pugarch-frontend.vercel.app/buyer/register)
- [Login](https://msme-pugarch-frontend.vercel.app/login)

## About

JsgSmile (Jharsuguda Synergy for MSME and Industry Linkage Ecosystem) is a government-backed digital procurement portal enabling MSMEs in Jharsuguda district to connect with large industries, participate in tenders, and sell products through a transparent e-procurement platform.
